zh.caption: 兩種掃描的觀察範圍
zh.description: 概念示意：兩條路徑是互補的觀察方式，不是破解系統的先後步驟。

items.title: 公司 Linux 伺服器
items.body: 網站服務、作業系統、套件、設定檔

items.title: 未登入掃描
items.body:
觀察網路回應、開放的服務、公開版本資訊

「外面看得到什麼？」

items.title: 已登入掃描
items.body:
依帳號權限查看套件版本、修補紀錄、系統設定

「裡面實際裝了什麼？」

en.caption: Two observation scopes
en.description: Conceptual illustration: these paths are complementary observations, not successive steps for breaking into a system.

items.title: Company Linux server
items.body: Website service, operating system, packages and configuration files

items.title: Scan without login
items.body:
Observe network responses, exposed services and public version information.

“What can be seen from outside?”

items.title: Scan with login
items.body:
Inspect package versions, patch records and system settings within the account privileges.

“What is actually installed inside?”

zh.caption: 掃描的三道關卡
zh.description: 從任務狀態逐項核對設定、認證與覆蓋，再依實際證據判讀。

items.title: 掃描任務已經結束
items.body: 這只是工作狀態，不是安全結論

items.title: 第一關：設定（Configuration）
items.body:
這次掃描真的有使用你設定的帳號嗎？

帳號放進掃描工具，不代表已指派給目標。

items.title: 第二關：認證（Authentication）
items.body:
目標系統有沒有接受這個帳號？

帳號過期、SSH 連不上、帳號被鎖，都可能失敗。

items.title: 第三關：覆蓋（Coverage）
items.body:
登入後，必要的檢查項目真的有成功執行嗎？

能登入，不代表有權讀取套件清單、設定或紀錄。

items.title: 依據實際取得的證據判讀
items.body: 說明已確認事項、未完成檢查及未知風險

en.caption: Three gates for interpreting a scan
en.description: Starting with the job status, check configuration, authentication and coverage, then interpret the evidence.

items.title: Scan job ended
items.body: This is a job status, not a security conclusion.

items.title: Gate 1: Configuration
items.body:
Did this scan actually use the account you configured?

Saving an account in the scanner does not mean it was assigned to the target.

items.title: Gate 2: Authentication
items.body:
Did the target system accept this account?

An expired or locked account or unreachable SSH service can cause failure.

items.title: Gate 3: Coverage
items.body:
After login, did the necessary checks actually succeed?

Logging in does not establish permission to read the package inventory, settings or logs.

items.title: Interpret the evidence actually obtained
items.body: Explain confirmed facts, unfinished checks and unknown risks.

items.body: 已完成

items.body: 成功

items.body: Permission denied
